the HCAI framework clarifies how human centered design can lead to Trusted, Reliable, Safe (TRS) technologies that offer high human control and high computer automation, which in turn can dramatically increase human performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
designing and building AI technologies that are human centered.
the development of human centered artificial intelligence (HCAI), which is a new approach to the design of AI systems.
the design of technologies that offer high level of human control and automation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

human centered artificial intelligence is a new paradigm that will lead to more effective human-machine systems, and that will be a critical factor in the future of work, the future of society, the future of business, and the future of warfare.
HCAI is the best way forward for the development of safe and reliable AI.
HCAI is the best way to achieve TRS and increase human performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the human is at the center of the AI design and that we need to design AI to work with humans, and not replace them.
HCAI is a new paradigm for the design of technologies that will be more widely adopted and used because of the high levels of human performance that they enable.

we have a new framework for designing AI that is human centric, that we have demonstrated that the framework works in practice, and that the framework is a significant advance over the existing approaches to AI.

human performance is not the sum of human and computer performance.
the HCAI framework is a new way to design AI systems that are TRS.
the HCAI framework can be used to design for high levels human control and high degrees of computer automation, so as to increase performance.
